# klms 0.2.2

## Correctness

- `klms today` and `klms upcoming` no longer fail with `UPSTREAM_SHAPE_CHANGED`
  when a calendar event has no date at all, such as a quiz with no close date.
  Undated events are skipped and a warning points to `klms calendar list`. An
  event whose time is present but unreadable is still an error, because that
  suggests the upstream markup changed. Thanks to @Jeon0001 for the fix.

## Security

- Update `rustls` to 0.23.45 for GHSA-2mjx-qc3c-rqvc (RUSTSEC-2026-0285), which
  accepted TLS 1.3 handshake messages at the wrong encryption level. The
  handshake transcript stays authenticated, so this is a defense-in-depth fix.
  The baseline cargo-vet exemption moves to the new version; it is recorded as
  an unaudited carry-over in `supply-chain/BASELINE.md`.

## Development checks

- Update the pinned `astral-sh/setup-uv` action to v10.2.0 (full commit SHA).

No command grammar, JSON envelope version, or SQLite migration changes.
